results.question: Which elements have the fewest atom occurrences across non-carcinogenic molecules? Include all elements tied for the minimum.
results.sql: WITH counts AS ( SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS n FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY a.element ) SELECT element FROM counts WHERE n = (SELECT MIN(n) FROM counts) ORDER BY element

FROM atom a
